title: Find a User
description: Search any HylooSec user using their unique 10-digit User ID and start a conversation.

blocks.text: The Find User feature allows you to search for any HylooSec user using their unique 10-digit User ID. Once a user is found, you can immediately start a conversation.

items.title: Open Sidebar
items.description: Locate the Find User icon in the application sidebar.

items.title: Open Search Window
items.description: Click the Find User icon to open the search popup.

blocks.text: Enter the user's unique 10-digit User ID into the search box and click the Search button.

fields.name: User ID
fields.description: Enter the exact 10-digit HylooSec User ID.
fields.important: Only numeric User IDs are supported.

items.title: View Result
items.description: If the account exists, HylooSec displays the user's information.

items.name: Profile Image
items.description: Displays the user's current profile picture when available.

items.name: User Name
items.description: Displays the user's HylooSec display name.

items.name: Bio
items.description: Displays the user's profile bio or mood.

items.name: Message Button
items.description: Allows you to immediately begin chatting with the user.

blocks.text: Click the Message button to begin chatting with the selected user.

items.title: Click Message
items.description: Select the Message button shown with the search result.

items.title: Conversation Created
items.description: If no previous conversation exists, HylooSec automatically creates one.

items.title: Existing Conversation
items.description: If a conversation already exists, it is opened directly.

blocks.text: Click the Close (X) button to close the Find User popup without starting a conversation.

items.solution: Verify that the entered User ID is correct and belongs to an existing HylooSec account.
Check your internet connection and verify the User ID.
The user may not exist or the search request may not have completed successfully.

items: Users can only be searched using their unique User ID.
Searching by name, bio or profile details is not supported.
Always verify the User ID before starting a conversation.
Only share your User ID with people you trust.

popup.title: Find User Help
content: Close the popup using the X button when finished.
